_comment: svg2tgs translation. Strings only: {name} is a placeholder, keep it as is. Check: npm run check-locales.
dropHint: Files or folders. You can also paste SVG code — Ctrl+V.
clearHint: Remove all files from the list
exportHint: Save all files in the list as TGS
toSourceHint: Each TGS is saved next to its SVG
scopeAllHint: Settings below apply to all files without their own settings
scopeOneHint2: Own settings for the selected file only
emojiHint: Custom emoji: shown inside a text line, thin lines nearly vanish
boundsContainerHint: The whole SVG area, with empty margins
boundsContentHint: The frame hugs the drawing on all sides, including its stroke width
scopeOneHint: Settings below apply only to {name}. Other files use the common ones.
fitCoverHint: Fill the square, the excess is cropped
fitWidthHint: Fit width; the excess at the top and bottom is cropped, move with Y
fitHeightHint: Fit height; the excess at the sides is cropped, move with X
precisionHint: Alt or Ctrl — smooth and finer · Shift — in steps (rotation by 15°) · Shift+Alt — finer, step 1. Mouse wheel — over a focused field.
cropHint: Crop and rotate with the mouse in the preview
ownSettingsToast: Edit applied only to {name} — the file now has its own settings
cropHelp: Edges and corners — crop · inside the frame — move · ● — rotate · Alt or Ctrl — finer · Shift — rotate by 15°
viewEmojiHint: Show as an emoji; thin line check
bgClipHint: The drawing and its outline are clipped to the rounded background frame
singleHint: One TGS for the whole drawing
sliceHint: Split the drawing into a grid of emoji — a picture made of several emoji
autoGrid: Fit the grid to the drawing's proportions, up to 8 per row
sliceInfo: {n} emoji · files {first} … {last}, row by row, left to right
sliceWide: More than 8 per row — Telegram will wrap the rows of the picture
sliceResult: As Telegram assembles it · {n} emoji, up to {size}
exportOneTiles: Export only {name} — {n} emoji of the grid
scopeSelectedHint: Edits below apply to {n} selected files. Other files keep their settings.
selectHint: Ctrl — add to selection, Shift — select a range
ownSettingsToastMany: Edit applied only to the {n} selected files — they now have their own settings
warn_filter_removed: “{filter}” effect is not supported in Telegram and was removed
warn_mask_removed: Mask is not supported and was removed
warn_image_removed: Raster image inside the SVG is not supported and was removed
warn_blend_mode_ignored: Blend mode “{mode}” is not supported, normal is used
warn_simplified: Outlines simplified to fit the limit — up to {tolerance} px off out of 512
warn_too_complex: Shape is too complex ({points} points, limit {limit}): Telegram won't draw it
warn_thin_lines_for_emoji: {width} px lines (of 512) will nearly vanish in a text line — use {recommended} px or more
error_invalid_svg: The file is damaged or not an SVG
warn_size_over_limit: File is {size} KB, Telegram allows {limit} KB — simplify the drawing
warn_duration_too_long: Duration is {secs} s, Telegram allows up to {max} s
importHelp: Paste text copied with “Copy”, or JSON for svg2tgs --options. It applies to {target}.
importTargetMany: the settings of the selected files ({n})
importOk: Settings read: {n}, the rest are defaults
importErr_syntax: Cannot read: line {line}, column {column} — this is not JSON
importErr_value: Cannot read: line {line}, column {column} — wrong kind of value
importErr_not_object: Expected an object with settings in curly braces
importErr_newer_format: Settings from a newer svg2tgs — please update
importErr_too_large: The file is too large for settings
gridSize: Grid size: columns, rows follow the proportions
zoomHint: Wheel — zoom · drag — move · double-click — fit
tgLeadOff: Off: the app does not go online. Turn on to send finished TGS files to a sticker set through your own bot.
tgLeadOn: Finished TGS files go to your sticker or emoji set through your bot — only when you press “To Telegram”.
tgHelpAfter: using /newbot — it will send you a token. The token is kept in the system password store.
tgWaitStart: Send it /start in Telegram — this is how the app learns your account.
tgPublishGrid: Upload to Telegram — emoji from the {name} grid
tgPublishList: Upload to Telegram — a set from the files in the list
tgPublishNoBot: Upload to Telegram: connect a bot in Settings
pubSetAppendHint: Add to a set created by this bot
pubEmojiStickers: Emoji for search — each sticker has its own
pubEmojiCells: Emoji for search — each cell has its own
pubEmojiAllHint: Emoji for all: one or several. Emoji panel — Win+. or Ctrl+Cmd+Space
pubGridInfo: {n} emoji from {name}, grid {c} × {r}. Click a cell to give it its own emoji.
pubStopHint: Stop after the current request to Telegram
pubStoppingHint: Will stop as soon as Telegram answers the current request.
pubWait: Telegram asks to wait: {secs} s. It limits how often bots may send requests; the upload will continue by itself.
pubKept: What was uploaded stays in the set — we will continue from there.
pubDoneSub: The set is already in your Telegram account.
tgErr_disabled: Upload is turned off in Settings.
tgErr_no_token: No bot connected — connect one in Settings.
tgErr_storage: Could not save the token to the system password store: {detail}
tgErr_not_converted: File #{index} is not converted yet or has an error.
tgErr_invalid_token: Telegram did not accept the token. Check that it was copied in full.
tgErr_no_owner: Nobody has sent /start to the bot yet.
tgErr_webhook_active: The bot has a webhook set — it cannot be used for uploads. Remove the webhook or create another bot.
tgErr_name_invalid: Invalid address: Latin letters, digits and single “_” only, starting with a letter, up to 64 characters.
tgErr_name_taken: A set with this address already exists — choose another address.
tgErr_title_invalid: The title must be 1 to 64 characters.
tgErr_nothing: Nothing to upload: no converted files.
tgErr_emoji_invalid: File #{index} has no emoji or more than 20.
tgErr_set_mismatch: The set already has {existing}, and we are uploading {planned} — it seems to be another set.
tgErr_set_full: The set is full: it has {done}.
tgErr_unexpected: Telegram sent an unexpected response ({detail}). The connection may go through a proxy or a provider filter.
pubFoundNoRoom: “{title}”: {count}, room for {free} — fewer than the files ({n})
tgErr_set_missing: No set with this address. You can only add to sets created by this bot.
tgErr_kind_mismatch: This set is of another type: stickers cannot be added to an emoji set and vice versa.
warn_font_replaced: Font “{family}” is not available — the text is drawn with “{used}” and looks different
warn_glyphs_missing: Characters “{chars}” are missing from the font and are not drawn
error_internal: Internal converter error — please try again
webNoticeText: Everything runs in your browser; files are not uploaded anywhere. How the web version differs from the installed app:
webNoticePreview: the result preview is drawn by lottie-web, while Telegram uses rlottie: small differences are possible;
webNoticeFont: there is only one font for text in SVG — Noto Sans;
webNoticeSave: results are downloaded as a .tgs file or a .zip archive; an export folder can be chosen only in Chrome and Edge;
webEngineNote: In the browser the result preview is drawn by lottie-web, while Telegram uses rlottie: small differences are possible. The installed app shows the exact preview.
webFontBanner: The web version has only one font for text — Noto Sans, so the text does not look as intended. Use the installed app to keep the original font.
webFontToast: “{name}”: text is drawn with a different font — see the notes
webDownloadHint: A single file downloads as .tgs; several files and slices — as one .zip archive
webFolderUnavailable: In a browser, an export folder can be chosen only in Chrome and Edge. The installed app supports it everywhere.
webTelegramOff: Available in the installed app: Telegram does not accept requests from other websites.
pubSetOtherHint: Address of a set created by this bot
pubEditSetHint: Order, emoji, cover and removal of stickers in this set
pubCoverNone: Cover: the first sticker, Telegram's default. Pick another with ★.
pubCoverShrink: The file is over 32 KB: it will be simplified for the cover (Telegram accepts covers up to 32 KB).
pubCoverFailed: Stickers uploaded, but the cover could not be set: {error}
tgSetsHint: Edit this bot's sets: order, emoji, cover, removal
setPick: Choose a set to edit it.
setHint: Drag to reorder. Click a sticker for emoji, cover and removal.
setEmojiHint: Telegram only reports a sticker's first emoji; new ones replace the whole list.
setCoverTooBig: A sticker set cover must be up to 32 KB, this sticker is {kb} KB.
setConfirmText: This cannot be undone: removed stickers disappear from the set for everyone who added it.
setKept: What's done is already in the set — “Continue” finishes the rest.
tgErr_set_changed: The set changed since it was opened (stickers added or removed elsewhere). Open it again.
tgErr_thumb_too_big: The cover is over 32 KB — Telegram won't accept it. Pick a smaller sticker.
tgErr_cover_invalid: This cover doesn't fit: an emoji set's cover must be one of its emoji.
tgErr_delete_all: You can't remove every sticker: Telegram doesn't keep empty sets.
